personal.name: Alex Mercer
personal.title: Senior Cloud & Serverless Software Engineer
personal.summary: Results-driven Cloud Engineer with 6+ years of experience designing and deploying scalable, secure, and cost-efficient serverless architectures on AWS. Expert in AWS Lambda, Amazon API Gateway, DynamoDB, Python, TypeScript, and Infrastructure as Code (AWS SAM, CloudFormation, Terraform). Proven track record of optimizing distributed systems and migrating monolithic applications to event-driven microservices.

experience.summary: Lead architect for multi-tenant serverless APIs handling over 40M daily requests with 99.99% availability.
achievements: Architected and deployed a multi-region serverless REST API using AWS API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB Global Tables.
Reduced cloud infrastructure costs by 42% through fine-tuned Lambda provisioned concurrency, memory optimization, and DynamoDB on-demand capacity planning.
Implemented rigorous API key security, usage plans, rate limiting, and WAF integration across all public endpoints.
Automated continuous integration and deployment pipelines using AWS CodePipeline and GitHub Actions with 100% IaC coverage.

experience.summary: Designed event-driven backend services and transaction pipelines complying with PCI-DSS standards.
achievements: Migrated legacy REST services to serverless microservices powered by AWS Lambda and Amazon EventBridge, slashing latency by 35%.
Modeled DynamoDB single-table schema with composite partition/sort keys to support high-throughput sub-millisecond lookups.
Created CloudFormation templates for reproducible staging and production environments, standardizing deployment lifecycles.
Configured custom CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and X-Ray distributed tracing to improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) by 60%.

experience.summary: Developed RESTful APIs and backend microservices in Python and Node.js.
achievements: Developed and maintained 15+ REST endpoints with automated unit and integration test coverage exceeding 90%.
Built automated database backup and synchronization jobs using AWS Lambda and Amazon S3.
Collaborated with frontend teams to deliver high-performance user dashboards and authentication flows.
